title.en: An Act to Authorize An Increase in the Present Strength of the Philippine Constabulary, to Appropriate Necessary Funds Therefor, to Make Available for Expenditure Any Unexpended Balances of the Appropriation Made Under Act Numbered Forty-One Hundred and Eighty-Eight During the Unexpired Portion of the Year Nineteen Hundred and Thirty-Five, and for Other Purposes.

funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the purposes mentioned hereunder:

The sums herein appropriated shall not be made available until January first, nineteen hundred

and thirty-six: Provided, however, That immediately upon the approval hereof and during the unexpired
portion of the year nineteen hundred and thirty-five, any unexpended balances of the appropriations made
under Act Numbered Forty-one hundred and eighty-eight, shall immediately be available for expenditure
pursuant to the provisions of this Act.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, October 14, 1935.
